releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with improved interactive ownership enrichment controls from #363. Join-ShareSurferOwnershipSources -Interactive and New-ShareSurferOwnershipMappingProfile -Interactive now show a persistent controls line, support back/edit navigation, keep deliberate skips blank, offer a small header selector when there is no suggestion and fewer than 10 headers are available, and explain source type, authority level, and primary anchor choices in plain business language. Arrow-key selection is used where a real console supports raw keys, with numbered fallback for simpler hosts. Non-interactive DefinitionPath, mapping profile, and saved rerun workflows remain backward compatible. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
